spSecurity.title: SP security
spSecurity.missingCertWarning: {{count}} SP connection(s) require signing and/or encrypted assertions but have no SP certificate configured.

apiConnections.noConnectionsDescription: Create one to sync users, groups, and roles.

spConnections.noConnectionsDescription: Register a SAML application to enable SSO.
spConnections.spCertificateHint: Paste PEM certificate for SP signature verification.
spConnections.testSsoHelp: Use the example script to build a signed AuthnRequest redirect URL. Open the printed URL in a browser after syncing a test user.
spConnections.commandHint: Click the field to select all text for copying.
spConnections.jsonHint: Optional custom mapping object; invalid JSON is ignored until fixed.
spConnections.wantAssertionsEncryptedHint: Encrypt SAML assertions to this SP using the SP certificate PEM below (AES-256-CBC key transport). IdP encryption cert in metadata is separate.
spConnections.wantAuthnRequestsSignedHint: Require HTTP-Redirect SigAlg + Signature verification for this SP using the certificate PEM.
spConnections.wantAuthnRequestsSignedCallout: The IdP verifies detached Redirect signature parameters (SigAlg and Signature) against this SP certificate. XML signatures inside AuthnRequest are not checked here.
spConnections.wantAuthnRequestsSignedMetadataHint: IdP metadata setting wantAuthnRequestsSigned is advisory only; this SP-level flag enforces request signature verification.
spConnections.probeSigningHint: Paste an SP private key to verify it matches the stored SP certificate. The key is never saved.
spConnections.probeSigningFailed: Private key does not match SP certificate.
spConnections.testSsoWarningCallout: Test URLs are for operator validation only. Keep private key material out of browser history, logs, and screenshots.
spConnections.testSsoEphemeralKeyWarning: Signed URL used an ephemeral server key. Verification only succeeds if the generated key matches the uploaded SP certificate.
spConnections.testSsoEcKeyAgreementWarning: The IdP encryption key is an EC key. This encrypted test URL uses ECDH-ES (XML Encryption 1.1). The target SP must support xenc11:AgreementMethod — not all SP implementations do.
spConnections.probeSigningOpenEditLink: Open SP edit page to validate signing key/certificate pair
spConnections.sloUrlHint: L'endpoint SP a cui l'IdP invia la LogoutResponse. Facoltativo.
spConnections.wantLogoutRequestsSignedHint: Se abilitato, le LogoutRequest in ingresso devono avere una firma valida. Richiede un certificato SP.

idpSettings.encryptionEcKeyAgreementInfo: EC encryption key — ECDH-ES key agreement (XML Encryption 1.1). Service Providers must support xenc11:AgreementMethod. RSA keys are more widely compatible.
idpSettings.title: Impostazioni IdP
idpSettings.subtitle: Global SAML Identity Provider configuration
idpSettings.entityIdMismatch: Entity ID differs from IDP_BASE_URL. Service providers must update IdP metadata and trust after entity ID changes.
idpSettings.certExpiresWarning: Signing certificate expires on {{date}} — plan renewal or rotation.
idpSettings.defaultNameIdHint: Used in IdP metadata only. Assertion NameID still comes from each SP connection.
idpSettings.wantAuthnRequestsSignedHint: Advertise signing preference in IdP metadata (does not enforce SP verification by itself).
idpSettings.wantAuthnRequestsSignedCallout: Setting wantAuthnRequestsSigned in metadata advertises preference to SPs. Enforce signatures per SP connection.
idpSettings.rotationStale: Rotation started {{date}} — complete cutover or cancel to avoid prolonged dual-cert metadata.
idpSettings.rotationStep1: Verify metadata preview shows two signing KeyDescriptor entries (primary + pending).
idpSettings.rotationStep2: Update SP trust — distribute updated IdP metadata to every SP.
idpSettings.rotationStep3: Test SSO with at least one SP-initiated login before completing rotation.
idpSettings.lazyAutoGenNote: Lazy auto-generation still exists as a dev/test fallback when no certificate is configured, but operators should configure signing material explicitly in production.
idpSettings.confirmGeneratePrimary: Generate a new primary certificate? This replaces the existing primary immediately.
idpSettings.confirmUploadPrimary: Upload replaces the existing primary certificate immediately. Continue?
idpSettings.confirmStartRotation: Start certificate rotation? Metadata will publish two signing certificates.
idpSettings.confirmCompleteRotation: Complete rotation? Pending certificate becomes primary. SPs must already trust the new certificate.
idpSettings.confirmCancelRotation: Cancel rotation and discard the pending certificate?
idpSettings.successRotationStarted: Rotation started with a newly generated pending certificate.
idpSettings.rotationAlgorithmMismatchWarning: Pending certificate uses a different signature algorithm than the active primary. SAML assertions still sign with the primary key until you complete rotation.
idpSettings.toastCertGeneratedViewMetadata: Signing certificate generated — refresh metadata preview below.

crypto.sha1Deprecated: SHA-1 signatures are deprecated. Confirm your service providers accept this algorithm before continuing.
crypto.spCompatibilityWarning: ECDSA signatures are not supported by all service providers. Verify SP compatibility before generating.

encryption.panelHint: Used for XML encryption of SAML assertions when SP connections request encrypted assertions.
encryption.certExpiresWarning: Encryption certificate expires on {{date}} — plan renewal or rotation.
encryption.rotationStale: Encryption rotation started {{date}} — complete cutover or cancel to avoid prolonged dual-cert metadata.
encryption.rotationStep1: Verify metadata preview shows two encryption KeyDescriptor entries (primary + pending).
encryption.rotationStep2: Update SP trust — distribute updated IdP metadata and encryption public cert to every SP that encrypts assertions.
encryption.rotationStep3: Test encrypted SSO with at least one SP that has assertion encryption enabled.
encryption.rotationStep4: Complete encryption rotation only after steps 1–3.
encryption.confirmGeneratePrimary: Generate a new primary encryption certificate? This replaces the existing primary immediately.
encryption.confirmUploadPrimary: Upload replaces the existing primary encryption certificate immediately. Continue?
encryption.confirmStartRotation: Start encryption certificate rotation? Metadata will publish two encryption certificates.
encryption.confirmCompleteRotation: Complete encryption rotation? Pending certificate becomes primary. SPs must already trust the new certificate.
encryption.confirmCancelRotation: Cancel encryption rotation and discard the pending certificate?
encryption.successRotationStarted: Encryption rotation started with a newly generated pending certificate.
encryption.rotationTransportMismatchWarning: Pending certificate uses a different key transport algorithm than the active primary. Assertions still encrypt with the primary key until you complete rotation.
encryption.toastCopiedSigningOptions: Copied signing key options into encryption form

crypto.rsa15Deprecated: RSA-1_5 key transport is deprecated. Confirm your service providers accept this algorithm before continuing.
crypto.spCompatibilityWarning: EC encryption keys are not supported by all service providers. Verify SP compatibility before generating.
crypto.contentEncryptionNote: Assertion content is encrypted with AES-256-CBC (fixed in v1).
